description: Defines a template class 'NoDestructor' that provides a way to create static objects with static storage duration that are only constructed on first access and never invoke their destructor, primarily to avoid static initialization order issues and destructor calls.

classes.name: NoDestructor
classes.description: A template class that manages object lifetime by constructing an object of type T on first access and never calling its destructor, to ensure static storage duration without destructor invocation.

methods.name: NoDestructor
methods.description: Constructor template that constructs an object of type T in-place with forwarded arguments.

methods.name: NoDestructor(const T &x)
methods.description: Copy constructor that constructs the object in-place from a const reference.

methods.name: NoDestructor(T &&x)
methods.description: Move constructor that constructs the object in-place from an rvalue reference.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Dereference operators returning references to the contained object.

methods.name: operator->
methods.description: Arrow operators returning pointers to the contained object.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the contained object.
